German Election Results Pressure Chancellor Merz; Ukraine Faces Funding Challenges

In Germany, Chancellor Olaf Scholz faces internal pressure following the Alternative for Germany (AfD) party's significant electoral gains in Saxony-Anhalt. The AfD achieved a historic win in the state, increasing pressure on Scholz's coalition government. Meanwhile, Ukraine is grappling with mounting economic challenges in its efforts to fund its ongoing war against Russia. Separately, thousands attended a funeral for Ratko Mladić in Serbia.
